caption: The drawing is rendered in pencil on a light beige background and features a central, detailed illustration of a lidded tankard or pitcher with a prominent handle and thumb lever. The main vessel is cylindrical, has a lid with a knob on top, and displays a gently curved, ornamental handle with a latch mechanism. Surrounding the central illustration are five smaller detailed drawings: the top left shows a front elevation of the handle with measurements; the top right presents a thumb piece with its measurements; the bottom left appears to show a circular final (labeled "Final"); the bottom right gives a small front view of the tankard; and the center bottom shows scale drawings of the spout in both front and side view. The overall composition is technical and structured, with each element labeled and precisely sketched in shades of grey pencil.
title: Pewter Tankard
